Common bubble box drawing for reading pages, comic pages and exported pictures. The retraction and opacity of ordinary bubbles and free bubbles can be set separately. The text will automatically adapt to the font size according to the size of the bubble; text fills the bubble as much as possible without changing its size. Free bubbles only refer to the boxes filled in by text detection in normal mode, and do not include bubbles manually added by users. Please adjust the fonts uniformly in the separate "Font Settings".

Normal and floating bubble boxes share this font setting. Choose the system default or switch among uploaded fonts; uploaded fonts stay in the list so you do not need to re-upload them. Most system fonts fall back to the same Chinese glyphs and look almost the same.

After turning it on, it will first recognize all the image text and extract the translation, and then translate the bubble content on the entire page. The translation speed of the first picture after it is turned on depends on the total number of pictures. After turning it off, the speed of translating the first image is greatly improved.
After turning off translation processing, concurrent translation can be performed faster.

Bubbles only uses the bubble segmentation model. Text only uses Paddle OCR to detect and group every text block, and is the fastest mode. Bubbles + free text detects regular bubbles and uses Paddle OCR to supplement and group text outside them, and is the slowest mode. If bubbles appear to fly around or shift noticeably, switch to Bubbles only mode.
